 Western low-pressure system brings partial weather changes across the country
 By: ApEx BUREAU 
 Published: Nov. 16, 2026, 8:30 a.m. 
 A 
 A 
 A western low-pressure system is currently having a partial effect on the country. 
 The Himalayan and Hilly regions of Koshi, Bagmati and Gandaki Provinces are partly cloudy, while most of the rest of the country is experiencing fair weather. 
 According to the meteorological forecasting division, light rain or snowfall is possible at one or two places in the Himalayan and Hilly regions of Koshi Province and in the Himalayan region of Gandaki Province.
